scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply usual-base --local --env dev && wrangler dev --env dev --port 8799
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply usual-base --remote --env="" && wrangler deploy --env=""
scripts.check: node scripts/embed.mjs && wrangler types >/dev/null && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && node --test test/*.test.ts
